description.value: Taco Luis is a Mexican-style fast-food counter celebrating 25 years at Lansdowne Shopping Centre in Richmond, serving crispy tacos, burritos, taco salads, and loaded nacho dishes. The mall food-court setting means quick service and a reliable stop for a hot meal mid-ride in the Richmond area. Delivery via Uber, DoorDash, and SkipTheDishes is also available for those coordinating a rest stop.
